findings.desc: validate.ts path masks infra failures as validation_failure when blocking worktree pollution exists
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in implementer commit 2efb3fbe1: validate.ts render path now preserves commandResult.failureKind for timedOut/runner infra failures even when blocking worktree pollution is present, while plain pollution/ordinary validation failures remain validation_failure. Re-verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js.
